precepts.text: Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me; fight against them that fight against me. Watch and pray for protection and deliverance, and that none of us drift or get isolated.
precepts.point: Take ye heed, watch and pray, for ye know not when the time is. Stay ready.

note.label: Prepare Ye War

precepts.why:
Christ said, “Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.” You don't know when the time is coming, so you need to stay prepared, stay ready. The prophecy is unfolding before our eyes: the ten horns giving their kingdoms to the beast, NATO sending weapons and troops here and there, and a time coming when those horns will hate the whore.

So what do we pray for? David shows us: “Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.” Watch and pray for protection and deliverance, asking the Lord to fight against them that fight against us.

Watch and pray that none of us drift, get isolated, or get taken by sin and deception. You can pray for that. These Black Christians don't know what to pray for, but the scripture shows you: pray for the Lord to plead our cause against them that strive with us.

precepts.text: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things. Pray for prophecy to be fulfilled and that the enemy's plots be exposed, and that you are worthy to stand before Christ when it comes.
precepts.point: Take ye heed, watch and pray, for ye know not when the time is. Stay ready.

note.label: Prepare Ye War

precepts.why:
“Take ye heed, watch and pray”, and Christ tells us what to watch and pray for: “Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.”

Watch and pray for the destruction of their wicked devices: that the traps, the plots and the lies of the enemy be exposed and broken. Ask the Most High to show you.

Pray for prophecy to be fulfilled. And pray that you are worthy to stand before Christ when these things come. We see all this unfolding, the nations moving and the empire declining, so the prayer is not for these things to be stopped but for us to be found worthy to escape them and stand before the Son of man.

precepts.text: The end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer, and above all things have fervent charity among yourselves.
precepts.point: Take ye heed, watch and pray, for ye know not when the time is. Stay ready.

note.label: Prepare Ye War

precepts.why:
Christ said to watch and pray, “for ye know not when the time is.” Peter says the same: “But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.” Be sober, man. Keep a clear mind.

“And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.” Fervent charity is the brotherly love we are supposed to have for one another, the way we are supposed to treat one another.

We need it because these things are taking place, and we see them taking place on the earth. The end of all things is at hand, so watching and praying goes together with a clear mind and with love among ourselves.

precepts.text: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving. Watch and pray for your household, because if the house fails the nation gets weaker; it is not good for man to be alone.
precepts.point: Take ye heed, watch and pray, for ye know not when the time is. Stay ready.

note.label: Prepare Ye War

precepts.why:
Watching and praying is not only for the nation at large. “Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving”. Watch and pray for your household, your children, your brothers and sisters, because if the house fails, the nation gets weaker.

That is why marriage classes keep coming up. The scripture says it is not good for man to be alone. Some brothers think they are strong enough to do it without her, but it is not good that you should be alone; two are better than one.

And watch in the same with thanksgiving: be thankful for the things you have right now, because some people are in a way worse position than you. So continue in prayer, be thankful, and keep preparing, because you do not know when the time is.

precepts.text: False Christs and false prophets shall show signs and wonders to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
precepts.point: Many shall be offended and betray one another. False Christs and false prophets shall seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

note.label: Christ: the Enemy of Christianity

precepts.why:
Paul says those who depart from the faith give “heed to seducing spirits.” Mark shows where that seducing spirit comes from: “For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.”

The false Christs and false prophets rise on TikTok and Instagram. These Christians under Israel's banner, the fake Israel's banner, get millions of dollars, and America works her science for Israel. Remember in Revelation how they called fire down from heaven, and that fire from heaven was called wonders on the earth. Those are the signs and wonders.

They rise “to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.” That lets us know there will be a seducing spirit in the last days to get us back into Christianity, back into colonialism, back into that damnable slave religion called Christianity. The seducing spirit that Mark, Matthew and Paul to Timothy all address is in these days.

Revelation names the three unclean spirits like frogs: out of the mouth of the dragon, politics; out of the mouth of the beast, the United States and its financial system; “and out of the mouth of the false prophet”, religion, which is Christianity. “For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles”, gathering the kings of the earth to the battle of that great day. So do not tell us the Bible is not true. If you want to play games and go back into Christianity, go; there are no bars on the door.

precepts.text: Watch, because you do not know the hour the master of the house comes, and what he says to one he says to all.
precepts.point: Matthew 24:36 kills the trinity: of that day and hour knoweth no man, no not the angels of heaven, but the Father only. If they are co-eternal and co-existing and all the same, why does only the Father know when Christ returns?

precepts.text: When ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
precepts.point: Woe to them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days, and pray that your flight be not in the winter. What that siege was is written in the law.

note.label: Mark 13: The Signs of the End and the Charge to Watch

precepts.why:
“when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judea flee to the mountains”. Luke gives the same warning in plain words: “And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.”

The abomination of desolation standing where it ought not is Jerusalem compassed with armies. When you see the armies around the city, the desolation is at hand, and that is the moment to flee to the mountains without going back into the house for anything.

precepts.text: The nation from far, the siege in all thy gates, and the eating of the fruit of thine own body.
precepts.point: Woe to them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days, and pray that your flight be not in the winter. What that siege was is written in the law.

note.label: Mark 13: The Signs of the End and the Charge to Watch

precepts.why:
“woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days! And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.” What that siege was is written in the law.

“The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand; A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young”. That nation eats the fruit of the cattle and the fruit of the land “until thou be destroyed”.

“And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land”. That is Jerusalem compassed with armies. And in that siege: “thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the Lord thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee”.

That is why it is woe to them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days. The nation from far, the siege in all thy gates and the eating of the fruit of thine own body were written by Moses long before, and Christ tells them that day is coming on Judaea, so flee.

points: Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here: Herod made that thing look so good the disciples marveled at it. And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

Book read: The Temples That Jerusalem Forgot, by Ernest L. Martin: "When Jesus said the temple and the city of Jerusalem would be obliterated, his prophecies were accurate to a T. The historical records show that when the Romans got through with their fury in dismantling Jerusalem and the temple, no stones were left in place that would make one believe there was once a city or a holy sanctuary in the area. So thorough was the ruin of the temple, and also of Jewish Jerusalem, that scholars cannot find any stone of the temple still in place in its original location. My conclusions show that the Bible and history reveal the wailing wall was not a wall of the temple, but is the western wall of Herod's fort Antonia."

Everybody in the world thinks that western wall was part of the temple. Christ said there would not be one stone left, and now Esau himself is revealing that wall was Herod's fortress. Diagram shown of the Temple Mount with fort Antonia: that is the wall that was left, not the temple; the temple was totally destroyed. Every year masses of people go to that wailing wall to pray at Herod's fort.
